title: Consolidate System lowering into a single pass with a core Lifetime value type
description:
## Problem Statement

Lowering an authored **System** from its Protocol Buffer representation into an executable `CameraSystem` (AST structure plus externalized `TransformParams` keyed by `TransformIndex`) currently splits the **Blend** layout rules across multiple independent traversals:

1. One traversal builds the `ast::Transform` tree (`pre` **Affine Transform**, `WeightedSumTransform` of **Formulas**, `post` **Affine Transform**, and **Coloring Method** expression, plus enabled-**Blend** filtering and **Isolated Blend** selection).
2. A second traversal re-derives the exact same conditional branches to walk `TransformIndex` (`firstChild`, `nextSibling`, `parent`) and populate `TransformParams`.
3. The **Formula** preview generator constructs a third, hand-indexed `MultiStepTransform` with literal `TransformIndex{0}` and `TransformIndex{1}` paths.
4. **Particle** **Lifetime** rules (`[Min, Max]` or `Infinite`) are split across the QML editor, `SystemModel`, `SystemView`, and `SystemProcessor`, and **Lifetime** is passed to the generator over a separate side channel (`setLifetimeRange`) after `setSystem`. Because `SystemModel::setMinLifetime` compares `min > max_lifetime` directly, editing `minLifetime` while `isInfiniteLifetime` is active (`max_lifetime == -1`) is broken and rejects every non-negative value.
5. Unchecked inputs in loaded or hand-edited **Project** files—such as an unrecognized **Formula** type string or an out-of-range **Isolated Blend** index—throw or read out of bounds on the GUI thread during lowering, and invalid **Lifetime** values only log a console warning without normalizing the state or informing the user in the UI.

## Solution

Consolidate **System** and **Blend** lowering into a single-pass lowering module and introduce a dedicated `Lifetime` value type carried directly inside `CameraSystem`:

- A single-pass lowering builder walks each **Blend** and **System** once, emitting AST nodes and claiming their corresponding `TransformIndex` parameter slots simultaneously so structure and parameter indices cannot drift apart.
- Expose single-**Blend** lowering (`toTransformSystem`) alongside full **System** lowering (`toCameraSystem`) so the **Formula** preview provider reuses the same lowering module instead of hardcoding `TransformIndex` paths.
- Introduce a `Lifetime` value type in `core` that enforces the `[Min, Max]` / `Infinite` invariant, normalizes out-of-range values when needed, and encapsulates initial random **Lifetime** assignment vs. deterministic revived **Lifetime** assignment (per ADR-0003).
- Embed `Lifetime` inside `CameraSystem` so `CameraSystemProcessor` applies it automatically and the separate `setLifetimeRange` channel across `Generator`, `HistogramGenerator`, and `BlenderTask` is removed.
- Make lowering resilient: sanitize invalid `Lifetime` bounds, skip unrecognized **Formula** types (omitting `WeightedSumTransform` if no valid **Formulas** remain), and fall back to enabled **Blends** when an **Isolated Blend** index is out of range, while recording human-readable warning messages that are logged and surfaced to the user via the main window's `Snackbar`.
- Update `SystemModel` to enforce the same `Lifetime` rules in the UI, fixing the bug where `minLifetime` cannot be edited when **Lifetime** is `Infinite`.

## User Stories

1. As a fractal author, I want to edit the minimum **Particle** **Lifetime** while **Lifetime** is set to `Infinite`, so that I can control the number of unplotted warm-up iterations even when **Particles** never expire.
2. As a fractal author, I want the UI to reject negative `minLifetime` values and `maxLifetime` values below `1` (unless `Infinite`), so that I cannot accidentally configure an invalid **Lifetime** range from the editor.
3. As a fractal author, I want `minLifetime` to automatically clamp down to `maxLifetime` when I switch from `Infinite` (or a larger maximum) to a finite `maxLifetime` smaller than the current `minLifetime`, so that the `[Min, Max]` invariant is always preserved.
4. As a fractal author opening a `.ck` **Project** file that contains an unrecognized **Formula** type, I want ChaosKit to skip that **Formula**, continue rendering the rest of the **Blend**, and show a warning in the `Snackbar`, so that the application does not crash on the GUI thread.
5. As a fractal author opening a `.ck` **Project** file where every **Formula** in a **Blend** has an unrecognized type, I want the **Blend** to lower cleanly with only its `pre` and `post` **Affine Transforms** and **Coloring Method** intact, so that the remaining steps still receive their expected parameter slots.
6. As a fractal author opening a `.ck` **Project** file with an out-of-range **Isolated Blend** index, I want ChaosKit to fall back to rendering all enabled **Blends** and show a warning in the `Snackbar`, so that an invalid isolation index does not cause an out-of-bounds read.
7. As a fractal author opening a `.ck` **Project** file with invalid **Lifetime** numbers (such as negative `min_lifetime`, non-positive finite `max_lifetime`, or `min_lifetime > max_lifetime`), I want ChaosKit to clamp the **Lifetime** into a valid range and show a warning in the `Snackbar`, so that the **System** still renders safely.
8. As a fractal author viewing **Formula** previews in the picker, I want the preview renderer to lower its example `pre` **Affine Transform** and **Formula** through the standard **Blend** lowering module, so that previews always match the parameter-slot layout used by the main renderer.
9. As a fractal author adjusting **Lifetime** settings, I want newly created **Particles** to receive a randomized initial **Lifetime** while revived **Particles** receive the full `maxLifetime` (per ADR-0003), so that startup transients are smoothed while **Lifetime** adjustments remain visually predictable.
10. As a developer maintaining ChaosKit, I want AST structure construction and `TransformIndex` parameter slot assignment for a **Blend** to happen in a single pass, so that changing how a **Blend** lowers only requires editing one traversal.
11. As a developer maintaining ChaosKit, I want `CameraSystem` to carry its `Lifetime` value directly, so that updating a **System** on a processor or generator updates its **Transform**, **Camera**, and **Lifetime** atomically through one interface.

## Implementation Decisions

- **`core::Lifetime` value type**:
  - Represents a **Particle** **Lifetime** range `[min, max]` where `max` is either a positive integer (`>= 1`) or `INFINITE_LIFETIME` (`-1`), and `min >= 0` with `min <= max` whenever `max` is finite.
  - Default value is `min = 0`, `max = INFINITE_LIFETIME`.
  - Provides a normalizing factory/constructor that clamps `min = std::max(0, min)`, treats `max == INFINITE_LIFETIME` as infinite while clamping any other `max < 1` to `1`, and clamps `min = std::min(min, max)` when finite, reporting whether normalization occurred so callers can emit a warning.
  - Provides helper methods for **Particle** lifecycle management following ADR-0003:
    - Initial **Particle** **Lifetime** draw: returns `INFINITE_LIFETIME` when infinite, otherwise `rng.randomInt(std::min(min + 1, max), max)`.
    - Revived **Particle** **Lifetime**: returns `max` (which is `INFINITE_LIFETIME` when infinite).
    - Warm-up count: returns `min`.
  - Supports equality comparison (`==`, `!=`) and debug stream output (`operator<<`).
- **Embedding `Lifetime` in `core::CameraSystem`**:
  - Add `Lifetime lifetime` as a field on `core::CameraSystem` (included in `operator==` / `operator!=` and debug printing).
  - `CameraSystemProcessor` initializes its `SystemProcessor` `Lifetime` from `CameraSystem::lifetime` in its constructor and updates it inside `setCameraSystem(const CameraSystem&)`.
  - `SystemProcessor` stores a `Lifetime` member instead of separate raw `min_lifetime_` / `max_lifetime_` integers (retaining convenience setters/getters on `SystemProcessor` where useful for direct unit tests).
  - Remove `setLifetimeRange(int32_t, int32_t)` from `core::Generator`, `ui::HistogramGenerator`, and `ui::BlenderTask`, and remove the separate `generator_->setLifetimeRange(...)` call from `SystemView::updateSystem()`.
- **Single-pass lowering in `ui/storage/conversions`**:
  - Replace the separate `toTransform` and `populateParams` / `toParams` traversals with a single-pass builder that tracks the current `core::TransformIndex` while constructing `ast::Transform` nodes and writing parameter vectors into `core::TransformParams` at the same time.
  - Expose two functions in `ui/storage/conversions`:
    - `core::TransformSystem toTransformSystem(const Blend& blendProto, std::vector<std::string>* warnings = nullptr)`
    - `core::CameraSystem toCameraSystem(const System& systemProto, std::vector<std::string>* warnings = nullptr)`
  - When lowering a **Blend**:
    - If `has_pre()`, emit `ast::AffineTransform` and claim the current child `TransformIndex` for its 6 matrix parameters.
    - For `formulas()`, resolve each `Formula::type()` via `magic_enum::enum_cast<library::FormulaType>`. If a type is unrecognized (or `FormulaType::Invalid`), append a warning message (if `warnings != nullptr`) and skip it. Only if at least one valid **Formula** remains, emit `ast::WeightedSumTransform` at the next step `TransformIndex` and assign each valid **Formula**'s parameters to its corresponding child `TransformIndex`.
    - If `has_post()`, emit `ast::AffineTransform` and claim the next sibling `TransformIndex` for its 6 matrix parameters.
    - If `has_coloring_method()`, attach the corresponding coloring expression to the `MultiStepTransform` and store its scalar parameter at the **Blend**'s parent `TransformIndex`.
  - When lowering a **System**:
    - Normalize `(min_lifetime, max_lifetime)` into `core::Lifetime`; if normalization adjusted either bound, record a warning message.
    - If `has_isolated_blend()`, check whether `isolated_blend().index()` is within `[0, blends_size())`. If valid, lower only that **Blend** at the root `TransformIndex`. If out of bounds, record a warning message and fall back to lowering all enabled **Blends** inside a `RandomChoiceTransform`.
    - If `has_camera()` and `camera().enabled()`, lower `camera()` via `toTransformSystem(systemProto.camera(), warnings)`.
- **Reuse in `FormulaPreviewProvider`**:
  - In `FormulaPreviewProvider`, build a temporary `Blend` proto with the example `pre` **Affine Transform** and single **Formula** with weight `1.0` and example parameters, and lower it through `toTransformSystem` rather than manually constructing `TransformIndex{0}` and `TransformIndex{1}`.
- **`SystemModel` validation and UI warning surfacing**:
  - In `SystemModel::setMinLifetime(int min)`: reject `min < 0`; if `!isInfiniteLifetime()`, reject `min > maxLifetime()`; allow any `min >= 0` when `isInfiniteLifetime()` is true.
  - In `SystemModel::setMaxLifetime(int max)`: reject `max < 1` unless `max == core::SystemParticle::INFINITE_LIFETIME`; when `max` is finite and `minLifetime() > max`, clamp `min_lifetime` down to `max` and emit `minLifetimeChanged()`.
  - When `SystemView::updateSystem()` lowers the **System** proto via `toCameraSystem(systemProto, &warnings)`, log any warning messages with `qCWarning` and surface them to the user via a signal wired to `openSnackbar(...)` in `MainWindow.qml`.

## Testing Decisions

- **What makes a good test**:
  - Tests should exercise modules through their public interfaces (`toCameraSystem`, `toTransformSystem`, `SystemProcessor`, `CameraSystemProcessor`, and `SystemModel`) and assert observable outputs (`CameraSystem` values, `Particle` states after stepping with a deterministic `Rng`, emitted signals, and collected warning strings), not internal helper functions.
- **Modules to be tested**:
  - `ui/storage/conversions`:
    - Existing tests in `conversions_test` updated to verify that `CameraSystem` includes the expected `Lifetime`.
    - New tests in `conversions_test` for `toTransformSystem(const Blend&)`.
    - New tests for fallback and warning collection: unknown **Formula** type alongside a valid **Formula**, a **Blend** where all **Formulas** are unknown (verifying `post` still lands at the right `TransformIndex`), out-of-range `isolated_blend` index falling back to enabled **Blends**, and invalid `min_lifetime` / `max_lifetime` clamping with warnings.
    - Behavioral round-trip test: lower a `System` with `pre`, **Formula**, `post`, **Coloring Method**, and **Camera**, run a **Particle** through `CameraSystemProcessor`, and assert the resulting **Particle** coordinates and **Color Coordinate** (verifying that lowered `TransformIndex` slots match `TransformInterpreter`).
  - `core::Lifetime`, `core::SystemProcessor`, and `core::CameraSystemProcessor`:
    - Unit tests for `Lifetime` normalization and invariants.
    - Existing `SystemProcessorTest` suite (preserving `CreatesParticleWithRandomLifetime*` and `RevivesDeadParticle*` per ADR-0003).
    - Test in `CameraSystemProcessorTest` verifying that `CameraSystem::lifetime` is applied when constructing or updating `CameraSystemProcessor`.
  - `ui::SystemModel`:
    - Unit test verifying `setMinLifetime` succeeds when `isInfiniteLifetime` is true, rejects negative values, rejects `min > max` when finite, and clamps `minLifetime` when `setMaxLifetime` lowers a finite `max` below `min`.
- **Prior art**:
  - `ui/storage/conversions_test.cpp`, `core/SystemProcessorTest.cpp`, and `core/CameraSystemProcessorTest.cpp` (GoogleTest / GoogleMock).

## Out of Scope

- Refactoring `HistogramGenerator`, `BlenderTask`, `GathererTask`, and `SimpleHistogramGenerator` into a Qt-free render session (tracked in `chaoskit-9gb`).
- Automatic child registration and change-kind propagation in `BaseModel` (tracked in `chaoskit-fth`).
- Managing `isolated_blend` index updates on **Blend** deletion in `SystemModel` and centralizing authoring defaults (tracked in `chaoskit-fu9`).
- Changing the initial random **Lifetime** vs. deterministic revived **Lifetime** behavior (recorded in ADR-0003).

title: Core Lifetime value type and CameraSystem integration
description:
## Parent

chaoskit-94f

## What to build

Introduce a dedicated `core::Lifetime` value type in `core/Lifetime.h` (and `core/Lifetime.cpp` if needed) enforcing the `[Min, Max]` / `Infinite` invariant, input normalization, initial random lifetime assignment, and deterministic revived lifetime assignment per ADR-0003. Embed `Lifetime` directly in `CameraSystem`, and update `SystemProcessor` and `CameraSystemProcessor` to accept and apply `Lifetime` directly.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `core::Lifetime` struct/class encapsulates `min_lifetime` and `max_lifetime` with methods `min()`, `max()`, and `isInfinite()`
- [ ] `Lifetime` constructor or factory validates/normalizes: clamp negative `min` to 0; if not infinite, ensure `max >= 1`; if finite and `min > max`, clamp `min` to `max`
- [ ] `Lifetime::normalize(int32_t min, int32_t max, bool* adjusted = nullptr)` provides explicit normalization logic returning normalized `Lifetime` and indicating if adjustments were made
- [ ] `Lifetime` encapsulates `createParticleLifetime(Rng&)` drawing from `[min(min + 1, max), max]` (or infinite) and `revivedLifetime()` returning `max` (or infinite) and `warmup = min` per ADR-0003
- [ ] `CameraSystem` contains `Lifetime lifetime` field and equality operators account for it
- [ ] `CameraSystemProcessor` applies `cameraSystem.lifetime` on construction and `setCameraSystem`
- [ ] Unit tests in `LifetimeTest` verify invariant enforcement, normalization, and ADR-0003 lifetime generation
- [ ] Existing `SystemProcessorTest` suite continues to pass
- [ ] `make test` and `make lint` pass

title: SystemModel lifetime validation and infinite lifetime editing fix
description:
## Parent

chaoskit-94f

## What to build

Update `SystemModel::setMinLifetime` and `SystemModel::setMaxLifetime` to fix the bug where `minLifetime` cannot be edited while `isInfiniteLifetime` is true, enforce valid lifetime bounds in the UI model, and automatically maintain the `[Min, Max]` invariant.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `SystemModel::setMinLifetime(int min)` allows editing any `min >= 0` when `isInfiniteLifetime()` is true
- [ ] `SystemModel::setMinLifetime(int min)` rejects `min < 0` and rejects `min > maxLifetime()` when finite
- [ ] `SystemModel::setMaxLifetime(int max)` rejects `max < 1` unless `max == core::SystemParticle::INFINITE_LIFETIME`
- [ ] When `max` is finite and `minLifetime() > max`, `SystemModel::setMaxLifetime` clamps `min_lifetime` down to `max` and emits `minLifetimeChanged()`
- [ ] Unit tests in `SystemModelTest` verify `setMinLifetime` with infinite lifetime, invalid inputs, and clamping behavior
- [ ] `make test` and `make lint` pass

title: Single-pass System and Blend lowering with resilience and warnings
description:
## Parent

chaoskit-94f

## What to build

Consolidate System and Blend lowering in `ui/storage/conversions` into a single-pass lowerer that walks the Protocol Buffer representation once, emitting AST nodes and claiming corresponding `TransformIndex` parameter slots simultaneously. Expose `toTransformSystem` (for single Blend) and `toCameraSystem` (for full System), accept a warnings collection, normalize `Lifetime` via `core::Lifetime`, skip unrecognized Formula types gracefully, and fall back on out-of-range isolated blend indices.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Lowering walks each `Blend` once, creating AST steps and claiming `TransformIndex` parameter slots in lockstep
- [ ] Expose `toTransformSystem(const Blend& blendProto, std::vector<QString>& warnings)` returning `core::TransformSystem`
- [ ] Update `toCameraSystem(const System& systemProto, std::vector<QString>& warnings)` to populate AST, parameters, and `Lifetime`
- [ ] Overload `toCameraSystem(const System& systemProto)` for backwards compatibility
- [ ] Normalize `(min_lifetime, max_lifetime)` into `core::Lifetime` inside `toCameraSystem`, recording a warning if normalization adjusted either bound
- [ ] If a `Formula` has an unrecognized type, skip it, record a warning, and if no valid formulas remain in the Blend, omit `ast::WeightedSumTransform` while preserving `pre`, `post`, and coloring method at correct `TransformIndex` slots
- [ ] If `isolated_blend` index is out of `[0, blends_size())`, record a warning and fall back to lowering all enabled blends in `RandomChoiceTransform`
- [ ] Existing `conversions_test` test cases pass with `CameraSystem::lifetime` verified
- [ ] New unit tests in `conversions_test` verify: `toTransformSystem(Blend)`, unknown formula skipping, all-unknown formulas blend, out-of-range isolated blend fallback, lifetime normalization warning, and behavioral round-trip through `CameraSystemProcessor`
- [ ] `make test` and `make lint` pass

title: Reuse toTransformSystem in FormulaPreviewProvider
description:
## Parent

chaoskit-94f

## What to build

Refactor `FormulaPreviewProvider` to construct a temporary `Blend` Protocol Buffer message with the example `pre` transform and formula, and lower it using `toTransformSystem` from `ui/storage/conversions` instead of manually instantiating `ast::MultiStepTransform` and hardcoding `TransformIndex{0}` and `TransformIndex{1}`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `FormulaPreviewProvider::createProcessor` creates a temporary `Blend` protobuf and calls `toTransformSystem`
- [ ] Literal `TransformIndex{0}` and `TransformIndex{1}` allocations are removed from `FormulaPreviewProvider.cpp`
- [ ] Formula previews render correctly without regression
- [ ] `make test` and `make lint` pass

title: Surface lowering warnings to Snackbar and remove setLifetimeRange channel
description:
## Parent

chaoskit-94f

## What to build

Capture warnings in `SystemView::updateSystem()` from `toCameraSystem`, log them via `qCWarning(systemViewLog)`, and emit a signal connected to `openSnackbar` in `MainWindow.qml`. Remove the obsolete `setLifetimeRange` channel across `Generator`, `HistogramGenerator`, `BlenderTask`, and `SimpleHistogramGenerator`, letting `CameraSystem::lifetime` carry lifetime configuration directly to the processor.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `SystemView` emits a signal (e.g. `warningEmitted(const QString& warning)`) when `toCameraSystem` produces warnings
- [ ] Warnings are logged via `qCWarning(systemViewLog)`
- [ ] `MainWindow.qml` connects `warningEmitted` to `openSnackbar(warning)`
- [ ] `generator_->setLifetimeRange(...)` is removed from `SystemView::updateSystem`
- [ ] `setLifetimeRange` is removed from `Generator`, `HistogramGenerator`, `BlenderTask`, and `SimpleHistogramGenerator`
- [ ] `BlenderTask` and `HistogramGenerator` rely entirely on `CameraSystem::lifetime`
- [ ] `make test` and `make lint` pass

title: Deepen Particle-to-Histogram rendering into a Qt-free core module
description: Collapse HistogramGenerator, BlenderTask, GathererTask, and SimpleHistogramGenerator into a single Qt-free core rendering module behind a thin Qt worker adapter. Unify the Particle-to-Histogram plotting rule, eliminate per-Particle QTimer/signal hops, make System swap + Histogram clear atomic to prevent stale Particle hits, and add headless tests with StaticRng.

title: Rename Final Blend to Camera across codebase
description: Camera is now the canonical domain term in GLOSSARY.md (replacing Final Blend). Rename FinalBlend / final_blend / finalBlend in ui/forms, ui/models, ui/storage/chaoskit.proto, and related conversions/tests to Camera.
close_reason: Renamed final_blend to camera across protobuf, C++ models, conversions, and UI

comments.text:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement
**Summary:** Rename Final Blend references to Camera across the protobuf schema, C++ models, conversions, and UI

**Current behavior:**
The codebase still uses legacy "Final Blend" terminology in multiple areas:
- `System` protobuf definition has `Blend final_blend = 2;`
- C++ classes (`SystemModel`, `ProjectModel`, `main.cpp`) access `final_blend()` and `mutable_final_blend()`
- Storage conversions and tests reference `has_final_blend()`, `final_blend()`, and test names like `ConvertsFinalBlendToCamera`
- `ui/resources.qrc` and `ui/forms` reference `FinalBlendIndicator.qml`

**Desired behavior:**
Align the codebase with the canonical domain terminology in `GLOSSARY.md` where Camera is the designated term:
- `final_blend` is renamed to `camera` in the `System` protobuf message (retaining field number 2)
- C++ model code, converters, and tests use `camera` / `mutable_camera()` / `has_camera()`
- Legacy references and filenames in `ui/forms` and `ui/resources.qrc` are renamed or retired
- Clean build and passing test suite

**Key interfaces:**
- `System` message in `chaoskit.proto`: `Blend camera = 2;`
- `SystemModel` & `ProjectModel`: bind `cameraBlend_` to `proto_->mutable_camera()`
- Storage converters (`conversions.cpp` / `conversions_test.cpp`): read from `systemProto.camera()` and verify transform/parameter mapping
- QML resources: replace `FinalBlendIndicator.qml` with `CameraIndicator.qml` (or remove if unused) and update `ui/resources.qrc`

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] Protobuf message `System` has `Blend camera = 2;` and no `final_blend` field
- [ ] All usages of `mutable_final_blend()` and `final_blend()` in `ui/` are replaced with `camera()` and `mutable_camera()`
- [ ] Conversions and conversion unit tests use `camera` and all unit tests pass
- [ ] No remaining occurrences of `final_blend` or `FinalBlend` exist within `ui/`
- [ ] `make test` runs and passes completely

**Out of scope:**
- Legacy `flame/` library and `lol.cpp` (these are deprecated and handled separately in `chaoskit-oma`)
- Modifying core rendering or math in `core::TransformSystem`

title: Deepen BaseModel to own child registration and change propagation
description: Have BaseModel own child model adoption and automatic change bubbling across ProjectModel, SystemModel, BlendModel, FormulaModel, TransformModel, and ColoringMethodModel. Distinguish metadata, parameter, and structural edits so ProjectModel derives modified automatically, SystemModel::addBlend notifies the view, QML debounce timers can be removed, and parameter-only edits update TransformParams without rebuilding the AST (realising ADR-0002).

title: Consolidate Isolated Blend, Camera rules, and authoring defaults in UI models
description: Have SystemModel own Isolated Blend state and index maintenance across Blend additions/deletions, move Camera-specific property rules out of QML into the model layer, and centralise authoring defaults for new Projects, Blends, Formulas, Coloring Methods, and identity Affine Transforms (fixing the launch-vs-reset Project mismatch and TransformModel::reset m12 typo).

title: Remove deprecated flame library and lol.cpp
description: The flame/ library and lol.cpp scratch executable are superseded by the Protobuf + Qt model stack (ADR 0001). Remove flame/ and lol.cpp from the repository and CMake build while preserving state/ as a standalone library.
close_reason: Removed deprecated flame/ library and lol.cpp from repository and CMake build while preserving state/ as a standalone library

title: Rename skip and ttl to min and max lifetime across proto and core
description: Lifetime [Min, Max] is the canonical domain concept in GLOSSARY.md (replacing separate skip and ttl terms). Rename skip and ttl in ui/storage/chaoskit.proto, core/SystemProcessor, core/SystemParticle, and related conversions/tests to match the Lifetime [Min, Max] model.
close_reason: Renamed skip/ttl/IMMORTAL to min/max/infinite lifetime across proto, core, and ui

title: Remove obsolete initial_transform field from chaoskit.proto
description: System.initial_transform in ui/storage/chaoskit.proto is an orphaned field from the removed SimpleInterpreter (superseded by SystemProcessor::Bounds). Remove initial_transform (and reserve tag 4) from chaoskit.proto.

title: Fix SystemProcessor lifetime warm-up and initial randomization
description: When Lifetime is [Min, Max], SystemProcessor::createParticle() randomizes ttl in [1, Max] instead of [Min + 1, Max], allowing a particle that dies before Min to be returned and plotted by BlenderTask before completing Min warm-up steps. Additionally, the warm-up loop in SystemProcessor::process() (for (; output.skip >= 0; --output.skip)) runs Min + 1 iterations instead of Min unplotted warm-up iterations on revival.
